findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 4 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 62 questions numbered 1-62; by section: 4.1 10, 4.2 8, 4.3 6, 4.4 3, 4.5 4, 4.6 10, 4.7 10, 4.8 8, 4.9 3.

Covers sections 4.1-4.9 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples with molar masses given, recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (STP 273.15 K, grams not mol, NaHCO3 is a solid, balanced 2NaNO3).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
